scope: Privileged imposed-velocity/imposed-load constitutive fixture; no Isaac, robot, MPC, active probe optimization, weight adaptation or confirmatory inference
posterior: Uniform mass on linear Maxwell mix grid, uniform mass on logarithmic BW age grid; known independent Gaussian force noise; likelihood uses only pre-update probe force samples
paired_counterfactual: Same physical probe and same future for sensed/blinded; blinded has no force likelihood; durations use prefixes of the same noisy probe realization
rest_control: same durations and N; v=0; force likelihood state-independent, so sensed posterior must equal blinded at every duration
